abstract.p: An ironic epigram on someone said to have died from smoking tobacco, questioning how taking in so much breath (through tobacco) could lead to losing it in death.

div.head: On one that Died with Tobacco

lg.l: If so hee died; then ---ly judge am I much in doubt,
How so much breath tane in could drive breath out.
